name: runs_read

select.description: Which read to run. A field marked [select: ...] applies only to the selects named.

runId.description: Run id: a UUID or a hex prefix of 8 to 32 characters. [select: get]

rootId.description: Only runs on this root. Item id: a UUID or a hex prefix of 8 to 32 characters. [select: list]

status.description: Only runs in this status: open, paused or closed. [select: list]

endedSince.description: Only runs closed at or after this instant (ISO 8601 UTC, for example 2026-10-13T00:00:00Z). [select: list]

unmarked.description: Only closed runs that do not carry this mark key (lowercase letters, digits, - and _, starting with a letter). Implies closed runs. [select: list]

cursor.description: The page.next value of the previous page. [select: list]

describe.description: true: return the operations, their parameters and errors instead of running the tool.

description: Read runs, the bounded budgeted passes over a set of items. select: get (one run) or list (runs, newest first, with status, endedSince and unmarked filters) or seats (a run's seat assignments). A run is outside the call scope when its root is. Call with describe:true for each operation's parameters and errors.
